new_finding.claim: The v1 split argument labels independently generated row sets but does not itself establish train/validation/holdout isolation.
source_basis: Prompt construction depends on atom triplet, S3 mapping, template, polarity, lexical variant, codebook order and seed; the split value is inserted later into metadata/family/provenance fields.
family_id is prefixed with TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT, so semantically identical family structure can appear different if a reviewer compares raw family_id strings without normalizing the split prefix.
The same atom file can be supplied independently to TRAIN, VALIDATION and HOLDOUT generation; no v1 cross-split atom-token disjointness check exists.
The same finite SEMANTIC_BANK is reused across splits; no v1 cross-split semantic-family or lexical-signature disjointness check exists.
The existing 8 generator unit tests validate within-set correctness but do not validate multi-file cross-split isolation.
new_finding.reproducer_hypothesis: Using the same admitted atom pool and same seed for separate TRAIN and HOLDOUT calls can reproduce the same model-visible prompt/target population while only split-tagged metadata changes.
new_finding.epistemic_status: SOURCE_DERIVED_STATIC_FINDING; NEW CROSS_SPLIT REGRESSION TESTS ADDED BUT THEIR EXECUTION IS UNOBSERVED IN THIS ORGAN

checks: cross-split normalized family overlap after removing cosmetic split prefix
cross-split semantic signature overlap: template_family x query_polarity x base_semantic_class x lexical_variant_index
cross-split normalized provenance overlap after removing the declared split segment
explicit holdout isolation on atom, family and semantic axes
new_guard.law: A split label, split-prefixed family_id, or selected_using_holdout=false flag does not establish independent train/validation/holdout populations. Isolation must be demonstrated across rendered sets.

swarm_review_delta.evidence_reviewer: ACCEPT finding: it follows directly from generator dataflow and existing test scope.
swarm_review_delta.shortcut_hunter: BLOCK any SEALED_HOLDOUT_READY promotion from independent v1 --split calls until cross-split audit passes.
swarm_review_delta.statistical_reviewer: Within-split exact class-symbol balance is necessary but insufficient; cross-split nuisance/semantic overlap can still make validation optimistic.
swarm_review_delta.goodman_reviewer: Raw split-prefixed family IDs are not independent ancestry. Family identity must be invariant to the dataset partition label.
swarm_review_delta.abi_reviewer: Dedicated unseen-symbol holdout requires token-id/text pools to be partitioned before row generation, not asserted after generation.
swarm_review_delta.final_integrator: Keep generator v1 as a useful candidate producer; require an external cross-split guard now and a split-aware v2 builder before dataset promotion.

required_properties: construct TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT together from one immutable split manifest
partition exact admitted atom token IDs before generation; reserve a dedicated unseen-symbol holdout pool
assign semantic/provenance families before rendering so the same family cannot be renamed into another split
keep an unseen-template family absent from both train and validation
compute prompt/content hashes across all splits and fail closed on overlap
bind every split manifest and row to exact model/tokenizer/ABI/generator identities
report nuisance-feature mutual information and positional/codebook-order balance across each split
freeze holdout identities before model selection or tuning consumes them

next_exact_trigger2_gate: Build a versioned split-manifest/builder that allocates disjoint atom pools plus independent semantic families before rendering, then execute both the existing within-set generator tests and the new cross-split tests on the exact candidate source.
